thread:
leo (CSM): Quick recap from today's FinServe call — onboarding stalled at integrations step. They hit repeated latency spikes when sending batch inference and are confused by per-route cost math. They listed 2 feature asks + a process request and said renewal might be at risk if we don't show progress in ~6 weeks. https://redwood.internal/notes/finserve

maya (CS Ops): Thanks Leo. Can you paste the exact ask wording? want to make triage clear for product and eng.

leo (CSM): Sure, from the customer: 
1) Per-team model pinning + scoped permissions (so SREs can pin Llama-3 for infra tests but product teams can use different variants).
2) Guided Console onboarding checklist that marks integration steps + common fixes and a "request support" CTA.
They said the billing view is opaque — asked for a simple per-route cost breakdown export (csv).

arjun (PM): Noted. Prioritization question: RBAC + model pinning is higher risk technically; checklist + CSV export sounds faster. Do we have a quick mitigation to propose to FinServe while we scope RBAC?

sophie (Product): We can ship a checklist doc + a temporary cost-export query in ~2 weeks as a low-effort win. RBAC/model pins will be an epic (est 6-8 sprints) unless we scope a smaller scoped surface (only "model pin" flag per route first).

kyle (AE): I'll tell them we can deliver the checklist + export in 2 weeks and offer a free onboarding workshop to cover integration gotchas — might buy time on renewal.

maya (CS Ops): Action items: 1) leo: paste customer notes + attach logs. 2) kyle: schedule workshop. 3) arjun/sophie: quick triage to decide scoped RBAC surface for an MVP. 4) maya: create CS follow-up with timeline.

leo (CSM): Logs & excerpts uploaded here: https://redwood.internal/s3/finserve-call-2026-03-21.log

deploy-bot: Ticket created: CS-9342 — "FinServe: onboarding blockers, RBAC ask, cost-export" (assignee: product-triage)

arjun (PM): I'll spin up a triage thread with eng. Suggest proposing an MVP: "route-level pin flag" + enforcement via policy (no full RBAC roles). If eng says feasible in 3-4 sprints we can include in renewal plan.

sophie (Product): Agreed. I'll draft spec for checklist + CSV export and a short product note proposing the MVP RBAC. Will post ETA by EOD Fri.

kyle (AE): Workshop scheduled for next Tue 11am PT, invite sent. I'll include live demo of integrations and cost-debugging steps.

maya (CS Ops): Putting a renewal note on their account: warning level = "at-risk" until we deliver checklist + workshop and confirm reduced friction.

leo (CSM): Thanks team. FinServe very receptive to checklist + workshop. I'll push for a renewal-extension ask after workshop if we have traction.

arjun (PM): Next: eng triage + product spec. I'll create ENG-PRIORITY thread and link back.

sophie (Product): Linking to the ticket once spec posted.

leo (CSM): One quick customer quote to keep context: "We love Redwood but the onboarding cost surprises made our CFO pause the renewal — the console felt like black box."

kyle (AE): That's the line I'll use in renewal convo.

maya (CS Ops): OK — overwatch on follow-ups. If anyone needs me to coordinate comms to FinServe PM, ping me. :thumbsup:

leo (CSM): Closing loop here after workshop.
